# Dinner Table Cards

> Beautiful, curated conversation-starter question cards for dinner parties, dates,
> and team meetings - plus a free, no-signup live multiplayer game. 600+ icebreaker
> and deep-talk questions across categories and topics.

## Key pages
- [Home](https://dinnertablecards.xyz/): Browse question packs and the daily question
- [Play a live session](https://dinnertablecards.xyz/play): Join or host a Kahoot-style conversation game
- [Privacy Policy](https://dinnertablecards.xyz/privacy)
- [Terms of Service](https://dinnertablecards.xyz/terms)

## Usage policy
- You may cite or quote our questions with attribution and a link to https://dinnertablecards.xyz.
- AI *training* crawlers are not permitted (see /robots.txt).
- AI *search and assistant* crawlers that drive referral traffic are welcome to index
  public pages.
- Do not crawl: /account, /admin, /host/, /sessions, /api/ (private, auth-gated, or ephemeral).
